## Labcoat Leni 13.1

Davey et al. (2003): *Don't forget your toothbrush*

Does the effect of the stop rule on checking depend on mood?

- `mood`: negative, positive or neutral mood induction
- `stop_rule`: "as many as you can" vs. "feel like continuing"
- `checks`: number of things to check before going on holiday
